Here is a hologram from my site:

![Image](http://www.designerinlight.com/holo/mermreflect.jpg)

This is a 4x5" dichromated geletin reflection H2 hologram that Dinesh, Joy and I made at their lab in San Diego. Here is a link to their work: [http://www.tripletake.com](http://www.tripletake.com). I helped a little but really the sucess of this image was the result of their skills which they were very generous about teaching me.
